question: Whether descriptive held-out PostgreSQL decision differences, tails, harms/benefits, and effective MCV coverage vary across real datasets, budgets, query shapes, and physically available MCV payloads.

dataset_gate.duplicate_sql_policy: canonical query fingerprints are grouped before splitting; shared fingerprints across train/valid/test are reported and do not become independent query IDs
dataset_gate.failure_policy: MISSING, INCOMPATIBLE, or BLOCKED prerequisites fail closed; no synthetic replacement or silent exclusion
dataset_gate.historical_canonical_hashes_are: references only; derived canonical hashes are the actual verified ETL identities

source_provenance.data_license_status: pinned upstream materials do not state a separate data-redistribution license; local validation only

forest10.candidate_universe_status: frozen_real_legacy_universe_from_issue23; not the stale synthetic instance.json

census13.candidate_universe_status: frozen adjacent source-column pairs; physical constructibility still requires Gate A

dmv11.candidate_universe_status: frozen adjacent source-column pairs; physical constructibility still requires Gate A

power7.candidate_universe_status: frozen adjacent source-column pairs; physical constructibility still requires Gate A

selection_and_model.source_query_and_truth_parser: the verified AreCEL ETL contract; truth is read only after the query-ID cohort is frozen
query_forms: at least two distinct constrained source attributes
selection_and_model.query_fingerprint: canonical source-query representation including table, ordered predicate semantics, and source-query SHA256
selection_and_model.candidate_conflict_strata: candidate-coverage and endpoint-conflict graph only; truth and estimates are not used
calibration_inputs: source-pinned PG trace and catalog payload
selection_and_model.test_leakage_policy: no test truth, test estimate, test trace, test cost, or test query outcome may affect candidate universe, model coefficients, selected sets, hyperparameters, or cohort membership
selection_and_model.model_loss: positive pre-clamp absolute log error; PostgreSQL rounded/clamped Plan Rows is secondary and not substituted

PESS.policy_knowledge: prescribed complete maximal-matching schemes are uncertain; task-wise worst cases are summed
PESS.selection: minimize the generic task-wise PESS objective under the additive proxy

Nominal.policy_knowledge: the frozen candidate order is treated as the known nominal policy
Nominal.selection: evaluate the fixed order induced scheme

Joint-Robust.policy_knowledge: one shared unknown policy/order is common across tasks
Joint-Robust.selection: maximize total loss over shared candidate orders, then minimize over resource sets

selection_and_model.solver_policy: retain all optimal ties; exact Fraction enumeration where tractable; floating-point solver optimality and duals are numerical unless independently certified

cost.interpretation: additive experimental proxy only; generic physical Maint is not assumed additive
cost.infeasible_budget_reporting: report INFEASIBLE rather than substituting a nearby budget

trace_requirements: ESS_MCV_TRACE selected statistic OIDs and claimed clauses
missing or incomplete trace is INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE
postgresql_protocol.creation_order: dataset candidate-list order; Empty creates none
postgresql_protocol.oid_policy: record actual catalog OIDs per snapshot; never predeclare or infer OIDs
postgresql_protocol.sample_policy: one approved fixed sample per dataset, replayed before every ANALYZE; sample identity and hash must be frozen before held-out measurement
postgresql_protocol.catalog_policy: record requested object, stxkeys, source columns/types, actual MCV payload presence/item count, build failures, and trace-selected objects
postgresql_protocol.cluster_isolation: Issue-owned disposable PGDATA, PGHOST, port, files, logs, OIDs, and database; no concurrent Stage 2A/2C cluster use
postgresql_protocol.repetitions_are: stability repeats, not independent query IDs or distinct samples

aggregate: paired deltas versus Empty and Nominal
strata: tail by true cardinality after cohort freeze
metrics_frozen_before_collection.paired_denominator: common valid query IDs only; invalid rows are disclosed and block a GO claim
metrics_frozen_before_collection.zero_and_missing_policy: zero truth is retained with T=max(1,N); nonpositive estimate, missing trace, unmapped OID, stale snapshot, or hash mismatch is INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE, never silently dropped
metrics_frozen_before_collection.physical_maintenance: reported in separate columns/domain from model loss and proxy budget
metrics_frozen_before_collection.plan_rows: secondary diagnostic only; not the pre-clamp metric

run_limits.maximum_new_measurements: predeclare exact count after Gate A and before execution; hard cap is 4 datasets * 4 budgets * 4 methods * 100 query IDs * 2 repetitions only if all are feasible
run_limits.setup_cap: predeclare per-dataset statistics creation/ANALYZE/query wall-time cap before execution
run_limits.resource_cap: predeclare CPU, memory, disk, and batch order in the runtime manifest

decision_gate.PASS: at least two real datasets complete matched Empty/PESS/Nominal evaluation, at least two feasible budgets per dataset, frozen independent test cohorts, complete traces, and reproducible nontrivial descriptive differences
decision_gate.NO_GO: the tested physical hypothesis has no nontrivial contrast under the supported workloads, with valid complete evidence
decision_gate.INCONCLUSIVE: complete evidence exists but the cohort is too small/unrepresentative or no defensible contrast is identified
decision_gate.BLOCKED: fewer than two datasets pass required data, source/build, trace, sample, or held-out prerequisites
not_claimed: population-level confidence by repeated same-sample runs

prior_artifact_boundaries.stage1a: experiments/forest10-heldout-decision-stage1a is read-only; its 60 test IDs are not new Stage 2B IDs
prior_artifact_boundaries.stage1c: experiments/pg-mcv-composition-stage1c is read-only; its 340 observations are not Stage 2B outcomes
prior_artifact_boundaries.legacy_forest10_selection: the real Issue #23 manifest is carried forward only as a frozen candidate-universe/reference input; the stale synthetic instance.json is not used
